Free invitations

Your party,
your style.
All the magic.

Who is coming, how many, and any allergies — that is genuinely everything you need to plan a children's party. Tiny Invites makes collecting all of it effortless. This is exactly what your guests see when they open your RSVP link: warm, simple, and designed to work beautifully on any phone. No app to download, no account to create. Behind the scenes, your responses are managed through Tally — a free tool that keeps every reply neatly organised in one place. See guest numbers, allergy details, and all the important information at a glance. When you are ready, export everything to Excel or CSV with one click — completely free. All you need is a free Tally account. No paid upgrade, no hidden costs. Ever. 🎉

A party for ___ turning ___ at ___ 🎂

04

Get your QR code 📲

In Tally go to Share → QR Code and download as PNG. You can add this QR code to a printed invitation so guests just scan and RSVP instantly.

05

Share with guests 🎉

Send your link via WhatsApp, text, or email — or print your QR code on invitations. All responses go directly to your Tally dashboard.
